name: mcp-tripwire
description: MCP Tripwire - a transparent, LLM-free security broker for the Model Context Protocol: manifest pinning, static poisoning scan, capability policy, and audit logging.
author: lukek0485 (https://github.com/luke0485)

scripts.scan:demo: node src/cli.js scan --name demo -- node examples/demo-server.js
scripts.wrap:demo: node src/cli.js wrap --name demo --log ./.tmp-audit.jsonl -- node examples/demo-server.js
